generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Extract goals, parameters, priorities, success conditions, scope and non-goals, while collecting only the relevant repository, file, attachment and historical context.

contract.purpose_user_function: Normalize goals, parameters, priority, success conditions, scope/non-goals, and relevant context into Requirement IR.
contract.valid_inputs: Raw text, attachments/research artifact, repository/file context references, inferred mode, and optional model rewrite.
contract.expected_outputs: Normalized requirement IR/raw-intent artifacts with goals, scope, constraints, acceptance hints, and traceable source text.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes intake JSON/IR artifacts under the run workspace.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Empty/malformed request, failed model rewrite, invalid artifact, missing required fields, or context read failure produces deterministic fallback/error.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Deterministic rewrite and IR build are shipped; automatic minimum-context selection across all history is partial.
contract.success_evidence: IR retains raw-input traceability, normalized goals/scope, and passes requirement-ir schema validation.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: minimal request; parameters; explicit non-goal; attachment; context refs; model rewrite success/failure; empty input.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§1 and 5; docs/UNIFIED_ORCHESTRATOR_DESIGN.md §2.1 Intent parser
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Deterministic matching is local; optional model rewriting depends on configured model access. Natural-language completeness and clarification policy remain partly heuristic.

implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
